'''Norn Girard''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] noble of [[House Girard]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Savorin Malfus the Seventh]] sought to earn Norn's favor. 

{{Char-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
Norn Girard appears as a character in the Bounty Hunter mission "Spiking the Punch" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as one of the people Savorin Malfus asks the player to deliver gifts to. Players can choose to do Malfus's errands for light side alignment points, but as the Bounty Hunter is an Imperial class and thus assumed to make the dark side choices, this article assumes that the hunter refused and beat up Malfus. During the optional contract by [[House Rist]] to assassinate the leadership of House Girard, Norn is not present.
